## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 2-fascicle proto-Mahāyāna *Niè-pán* text by [竺法護](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%AB%BA%E6%B3%95%E8%AD%B7) Zhú Fǎhù is one of the earliest Chinese versions of the *Pre-Niè-pán* / *Mahāyāna Mahāparinirvāṇa* tradition.

**Abstract**

The translation belongs to Zhú Fǎhù's Cháng'ān period (266–313 CE).
